race_context: The 'Decatur County School Board' races on the state list are for Decatur County Community Schools, whose central office is at 2020 N. Montgomery Rd. in Greensburg {dccs_min_20260812}. The district says nearly 1,800 students attend its schools {dccs_who}. It runs four schools: North Decatur Elementary, South Decatur Elementary, North Decatur Jr.-Sr. High and South Decatur Jr.-Sr. High {dccs_who}{dccs_dir}. The state list labels each race '(Decatur, Shelby)', meaning the district's voters include part of Shelby County {in_list}.
The superintendent is Dr. Jarrod Burns {dccs_central}.

The board has seven elected members {dccs_board}. The district lists them as Todd Mauer (president), Matt Hoeing (vice president), Lizette Bell (secretary), Nick Anderson, Elizabeth Hochstedler, Alison Ortman and Cory Ross {dccs_board}.

Seats on the 2026 ballot: four seats, District A (At Large), District B, District C and District D, each electing one member {in_list}{incitizen_list}. The same four seats were filled in November 2022. The Greensburg Daily News results listed one candidate in each race: Cory Ross (At Large), Todd W. Mauer (District B), Lizette Bell (District C) and Matthew J. (Matt) Hoering (District D) {gdn_2022_results}. The district's own records spell the last name Hoeing {dccs_board}.

Who is running again: Mauer (District B), Bell (District C) and Hoeing (District D) are on the 2026 ballot for the seats they won in 2022. Mauer and Bell each face a challenger {in_list}{gdn_2022_results}. Cory Ross, who won the at-large seat in 2022, is not on the 2026 ballot, so Rob G Smith is the only candidate for the open at-large seat {in_list}{gdn_2022_results}.

Budget and taxes (September 2025): the board adopted its 2026 budget at its September 2025 meeting. The Greensburg Daily News reported an Education Fund of $15,328,000, an Operations Fund of $6,200,000 (tax rate 0.44) and a Debt Service Fund of $3,943,000 (tax rate 0.46) {gdn_budget_2025}.

2025 property-tax law (July 2026): on July 8, 2026, the board voted unanimously to approve a 'Transfer from Debt Service to Operations for the New Supplemental Homestead Credit' {dccs_min_20260708}. The minutes do not give the dollar amount.

2027 budget (August 2026): business manager Melissa Leap presented the proposed 2027 budget, capital projects plan and bus replacement plan on Aug. 12, 2026 {dccs_min_20260812}. At the Aug. 26 hearing, the minutes record no questions or comments {dccs_min_20260826}. Decatur County Community Schools is not on the state's list of districts with a referendum on the November 2026 ballot {dlgf_ref_2026}.

Teachers (September 2025): the board agreed to a request from the Decatur County Education Association that the district not apply for the state Teacher Appreciation Grant. In a letter, association president Betsy Schwering said that under the redesigned program only 28 of 142 teachers could receive grants {gdn_budget_2025}. In August 2026 the board approved a supplemental payment of $500 per semester for the three teachers and one substitute teacher who travel between the North and South buildings {dccs_min_20260812}. The district has posted a teacher contract covering 2025-2026 and 2026-2027 {dccs_board}.
Facilities (February 2025): the board unanimously approved the Poole Group as construction manager for a transportation project {dccs_min_20250219}.

Forums: this guide found no candidate forum, questionnaire or news profile for any of these races. In the July and August 2026 meeting minutes, no public comment is recorded {dccs_min_20260708}{dccs_min_20260812}.
